The position vector r of a particle P (relative to a fixed origin O) at time t is given by r=⟨9t2−12t,4t+17⟩. Calculate the acceleration vector a.

a
a=⟨9,0⟩
b
a=⟨9t,4⟩
c
a=⟨18,0⟩
d
a=⟨18t−12,4⟩
e
a=⟨9,4⟩
